summary: Flexible Solutions International filed an 8-K solely to report its second-quarter 2026 financial results via press release and conference call. Sales fell 14% to $7.61M; net loss was $1.91M versus prior-year net income of $2.03M, driven by food-grade contract scaling costs, Panama plant training expenses, and a non-repeated $2.5M R&D payment. Management offered segment revenue guidance for Q3 but no strategic actions. This is a routine earnings announcement with no special-situation elements — no merger, tender, restructuring, or activist activity.
